{{Top|leg}}
A '''Low-Frequency Encryptor''' was part of the communications equipment installed on [[Uulshos Manufacturing/Legends|Uulshos Manufacturing's]] [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]]. The encryptor, along with other communications equipment such as a [[Subspace Scrambler/Transceiver]], [[Comm Analysis Amplifier/Receptor]], and a [[Long-Range Comm Transceiver]], allowed the Chariot [[Commander/Legends|commander]] to coordinate combat units in the field with up to date detailed intelligence.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
